fields.statement: QA at 2079b36f: read CLAUDE.md in the built tree; it names go test -trimpath ./internal/<pkg>/..., go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/<name> and make self-check as the agents' scoped commands, says agents in runs never run make check, make test or a bare go test ./... because GitHub CI runs make check before merge, and keeps make check only for a person outside a run. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestClaudeMDScopedTests$' passes.

QA at 2079b36f with a binary built from the branch: `rhiza guide build` prints a Tests section (builders and verifiers run only the tests covering what the change touches, never the repo's full suite: the PR's CI runs it) and `rhiza guide review` the same for checks, critics and fixers; neither contains go test, make check, make test or testscript. `rhiza guide install --agent claude` into a scratch HOME writes rhiza-build and rhiza-review SKILL.md files carrying the rule. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/guide/... passes.

QA at 2079b36f with the branch's binary: `rhiza guide plan` tells planners to write each leaf's acceptance as the tests covering that leaf, never the repo's full suite; `rhiza guide plan-review` widens missing-acceptance to an acceptance check that runs the repo's full suite; neither names go test, make check, make test or testscript; the installed rhiza-plan SKILL.md (scratch HOME) carries the rule. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/guide/... passes.

QA at 2079b36f with the branch's binary: `rhiza workflow describe build --json` shows both prompts (builder, verifier) and `workflow describe review --json` all 8 (five checks, critic, fixer, verifier) carrying 'never the repo's full suite', with none containing go test, make check, make test or testscript; `rhiza workflow check build|review` report valid (builtin layer). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/workflow/... passes, as do the prompt-printing testscripts run by name (autonomous-review, guide, arbiter-agent-tabs, run-agent-done, session-done-captures, session-run-tokens, inbox-advisor).
